tiles.title: Runtime Memory by Service and Type
Runtime Identity
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT
  "service.name" AS service,
  "service.namespace" AS namespace,
  "service.version" AS service_version,
  "host.name" AS host,
  "process.runtime.version" AS go_version,
  "process.executable.name" AS executable,
  scope_version AS instrumentation_version,
  MAX(p_timestamp) AS latest
FROM $metrics_dataset
WHERE metric_name = 'go.goroutine.count'
  AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service'
  AND COALESCE("service.namespace", 'unknown') ~ '$namespace'
  AND COALESCE("host.name", 'unknown') ~ '$host'
  AND COALESCE("process.runtime.version", 'unknown') ~ '$runtime_version'
GROUP BY service, namespace, service_version, host, go_version, executable, instrumentation_version
ORDER BY service

tiles.title: Go Service Inventory
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT
  "service.name" AS service,
  COUNT(DISTINCT metric_name) AS metric_families,
  COUNT(DISTINCT __series_hash_u64) AS series,
  COUNT(*) AS points,
  MIN(p_timestamp) AS first_seen,
  MAX(p_timestamp) AS last_seen
FROM $metrics_dataset
WHERE metric_name LIKE 'go.%'
  AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service'
  AND COALESCE("service.namespace", 'unknown') ~ '$namespace'
  AND COALESCE("host.name", 'unknown') ~ '$host'
  AND COALESCE("process.runtime.version", 'unknown') ~ '$runtime_version'
GROUP BY service
ORDER BY service

tiles.title: Go Runtime Sample Volume
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT
  date_bin('$bucket_size', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  "service.name" AS service,
  COUNT(*) AS points
FROM $metrics_dataset
WHERE metric_name LIKE 'go.%'
  AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service'
  AND COALESCE("service.namespace", 'unknown') ~ '$namespace'
  AND COALESCE("host.name", 'unknown') ~ '$host'
  AND COALESCE("process.runtime.version", 'unknown') ~ '$runtime_version'
GROUP BY time_bin, service
ORDER BY time_bin, service

tiles.title: Metric Freshness
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT
  metric_name,
  "service.name" AS service,
  COUNT(*) AS points,
  MAX(p_timestamp) AS latest
FROM $metrics_dataset
WHERE metric_name LIKE 'go.%'
  AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service'
  AND COALESCE("service.namespace", 'unknown') ~ '$namespace'
  AND COALESCE("host.name", 'unknown') ~ '$host'
  AND COALESCE("process.runtime.version", 'unknown') ~ '$runtime_version'
GROUP BY metric_name, service
ORDER BY metric_name, service

tiles.title: Go Metric Inventory
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT
  metric_name,
  metric_type,
  metric_unit,
  metric_description,
  COUNT(DISTINCT __series_hash_u64) AS series,
  COUNT(*) AS points,
  MIN(p_timestamp) AS first_seen,
  MAX(p_timestamp) AS last_seen
FROM $metrics_dataset
WHERE metric_name LIKE 'go.%'
  AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service'
  AND COALESCE("service.namespace", 'unknown') ~ '$namespace'
  AND COALESCE("host.name", 'unknown') ~ '$host'
  AND COALESCE("process.runtime.version", 'unknown') ~ '$runtime_version'
GROUP BY metric_name, metric_type, metric_unit, metric_description
ORDER BY metric_name
